summary: Comprehensive testing of Pre-Op Checklist v2 and Task System overhaul. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working. New 5-item default checklist, custom items, 3-task auto-generation all functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Imaging item uses special dropdown component (ImagingDropdown) - does not have data-testid on the item itself, but functionality works correctly
Existing tasks (Labs, Anesthesia, etc.) are preserved for migrated patients as expected per requirements
seed_data_creation: Test patients TEST_CHECKLIST_*, TEST_CUSTOM_*, etc. created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pre-op checklist v2 fully implemented: 5 default items (Imaging, Prior Auth, VSP, Ortho Approval, OR Scheduled), custom items with add/delete, 3 auto-generated tasks (Prior Auth, VSP, Imaging). Migration preserves checked removed items as custom. Existing tasks NOT deleted.

default_checklist_5_items.details: New patients have exactly 5 default checklist items: imaging, prior_auth, vsp_complete, ortho_approval, or_scheduled

removed_items_not_present.details: Labs Ordered, Labs Reviewed, Anesthesia Clearance, Medical Optimization are NOT in new patient checklists

default_items_no_delete_button.details: Default items have default=True flag and DELETE endpoint returns 400 for default items

add_custom_checklist_item.details: POST /api/patients/{mrn}/preop-checklist/custom-item adds custom item with default=False, checked=False

custom_item_has_delete_button.details: Custom items show X delete button in UI (data-testid='checklist-delete-{id}')

progress_bar_dynamic.details: Progress bar counts both default and custom items dynamically (e.g., 4/5, 0/6)

auto_generate_label_updated.details: Quick Add Patient checkbox shows 'Auto-generate tasks (Prior Auth, VSP, Imaging)'

auto_generate_creates_3_tasks.details: New patients with auto_generate_tasks=True get exactly 3 tasks: Prior Authorization, VSP (Virtual Surgical Planning), Imaging

add_task_free_text_input.details: Add Task form has free-text task name input (data-testid='task-name-input')

imaging_dropdown_works.details: Imaging dropdown allows multi-select of imaging studies, updates checked state based on selection

existing_patient_migration.details: Existing patients (5909932, 1416471, 6062024, 6011054, 602343) have 5 default items after migration

patient_602343_custom_item.details: Patient Will (602343) shows 0/6 progress - has 5 defaults + 1 custom item

calendar_prep_progress.details: Dashboard calendar shows Prep X/5 format (not X/9)

existing_tasks_preserved.details: Existing tasks (Labs, Anesthesia Pre-Op Evaluation, etc.) are preserved for migrated patients

dashboard_loads.details: Dashboard loads without errors, shows correct stats

notes: All pre-op checklist v2 features implemented correctly. The 5 default items are: Imaging (dropdown), Prior Authorization Approved, VSP Complete, Orthodontist Approval, OR Scheduled. Custom items can be added via '+ Add checklist item' input and deleted via X button. Auto-generate creates 3 tasks (Prior Auth, VSP, Imaging) instead of the previous 6. Migration logic preserves checked removed items as custom items with default=False.
